goal.text: Keep today's lands in place and bring everyone out of the great opening.

plate.narration: You are back on the glacier where it all began. The ice is blue and quiet and enormous. Even the wind has stopped to listen.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

npcVoices.Corvane: An old faun ruler, courtly, patient and confused. Certain about his remembered map, bewildered by today. Never threatens children. Short sentences. No conquer, punish, servants, destroy or hurt.
npcVoices.Orin Vale: Griffin scholar, practical and patient. Makes room for uncertainty.
npcVoices.Seren Wisp: Kitsune teacher. Holds conditions, never changes a rift's intrinsic rules.

arrival.narration: The walking passage opens above deep glacier ice. A great tear in the air shows faraway ground sliding past. Orin Vale, the griffin scholar, and Seren Wisp, the kitsune teacher, stop behind you. Farther in, a tall figure bends over an old map. Its ribbon keeps trying to stand straight up. "Keep today's lands in place," Orin says, "and bring everyone out of that opening."

variants.text: Olivia follows you in and waits on the safe ice, ready to help hold a brace.
A builder from the sheltered hollow brings the wyrm. They wait by the outer ice rib, ready to brace it.

retreat.narration: The walking passage gives you a broad way back. Run a handline along the wall to follow by touch, or place bright cloth marks to follow by sight.

retreat_line.narration: Pass the handline along the inside wall. Orin tucks the end under a blanket. His boot is off paperweight duty.

interaction.cue: Pass the line along the wall.

onSuccess.narration: The handline reaches all the way back.

onFailure.narration: The handline reaches all the way back.

onAssisted.narration: The handline reaches all the way back.

retreat_marks.narration: Seren points: wall, rib, passage, wall. Watch, then copy her before you place the cloths.

interaction.cue: Watch the route marks, then copy them.

onSuccess.narration: Your cloth marks show the way back.

onFailure.narration: Seren will place the cloths herself.

onAssisted.narration: Seren will place the cloths herself.

retreat_help.narration: Pass the cloths to Seren along the inside wall. She sets each one at traveler height.

interaction.cue: Pass the cloths to Seren.

onSuccess.narration: The cloth marks show the way back.

onFailure.narration: The cloth marks show the way back.

onAssisted.narration: The cloth marks show the way back.

voices.narration: The tall figure looks from an old river on his map to a river in the tear. "Why is it on that side of the mountain?" he asks. How will you show him who lives there now?

reveal.narration: The figure steps into view: an enormous faun with a long mustache tied back by a faded ribbon. "I am Corvane," he says. "Emperor of Pangea. Do you know how long I waited to see my rivers run the right way again?" Pangea was his realm, back when the lands lay in their old places. The glacier held him until the mountain's tremors loosened the ice. Now he is pulling the places back to his old map, and moving the homes built there since.

map_shelter.narration: A gust snaps Corvane's old map into the air. "Watch the corners!" he calls. Slide it into a dry case to keep its old marks safe. Or pin it open beside today's map, where he can see both. A missed catch could blur it.

map_case.narration: Corvane lets go of the corner. You slide the old map into its case from solid ice. He keeps one hand on the case for a moment, then lets you set it down.

map_shelter_check.narration: Guide the flapping corner under a smooth stone beside today's map. Corvane frees his ribbon first. His map seems to want a flying license.

interaction.cue: Catch the corner when the air goes still.

onAssisted.narration: Orin helps you pin it dry.

map_shelter_changed.narration: You set the damp corner flat to dry. A few fine marks have blurred. Orin writes down the damage honestly.

remember.narration: Your two accounts show places as they are now, with people living there. Lead the first anchor with one you learned, or let Orin guide you through your notes.

remember_guided.narration: Hold your first page while Orin points to its place on today's map.

interaction.cue: Hold the first page for Orin.

onAssisted.narration: One place holds still.

remember_paths.narration: Orin points to the copied river, today's path and the gap you never saw. Copy his pointing, and leave the gap empty.

interaction.cue: Copy Orin's pointing.

onFailure.narration: Orin checks the page with you.

onAssisted.narration: Orin checks the page with you.

remember_coast.narration: Orin shuffles your bridge drawing among today's map sheets. Follow it. The bridge stone stayed on its bank, and your copy is enough.

interaction.cue: Follow the bridge drawing.

onAssisted.narration: Orin helps you find it.

remember_sky.narration: Line up the copied boundary edge with today's island outline. Use only the groove you checked.

interaction.cue: Line up the copied edge.

onFailure.narration: Orin helps with the rough outline.

onAssisted.narration: Orin helps with the rough outline.

anchor_help.narration: Hold the page while Orin names its place with you. Saying a guess louder does not make it true.

interaction.cue: Hold the page for Orin.

onAssisted.narration: The place holds still.

first_anchor.narration: Keep that page steady while your other place is traced. Corvane stares at the homes and paths. "My old map left those out," he murmurs.

interaction.cue: Hold the page while the other place is traced.

onSuccess.narration: Two parts of the opening fold inward.

onFailure.narration: Two parts of the opening fold inward.

onAssisted.narration: Two parts of the opening fold inward.

first_anchor_clear.narration: Two parts of the great opening close. The ground stops sliding toward the old map. Seren frowns at the last seam. "It is still pulling."

rest.narration: Orin opens the supper bag from camp. You share dried apples and warm water inside a solid ice rib. Orin checks his boot for a lost apple ring. "A long day for this boot."

shelter.narration: Behind the ice rib, a yeti watcher has warm broth, a lamp and spare blankets. "I will keep the retreat open," she says. "But I will not go into the tear." Seren shows you the ridge brace inside the safe line. "Holding the ridge steadies the seam," she says. "It cannot change where it leads."

hold_condition.narration: There is time to prepare one thing. Fit the ridge brace now, and closing the seam will go faster. Or set up a wide rescue lamp, so a second try is easier if the fight goes badly. Both keep the way back open.

hold_condition_check.narration: Set the padded brace level against the marked ridge from solid ice. Seren checks it before anyone goes near.

interaction.cue: Level the brace at its mark.

onAssisted.narration: The brace is fitted.

hold_condition_3.narration: Your starweaver holds the ridge steady while Seren checks the mark. Closing the seam will go faster.

rescue_station.narration: Pass the lamp and bright markers to the watcher. They will make a second try easier.

interaction.cue: Pass the lamp kit to the watcher.

onAssisted.narration: The lamp is ready.

anchors.narration: Your two places hold the land against the pull. Corvane grips the last seam, and crawlers gather beside it. One more support would thin the opening and leave him less room. Or keep Orin and Seren ready on the rescue lane.

standard_plan.narration: Orin and Seren wait with the watcher on the rescue lane. Corvane stands strong beside the last seam, with two crawlers. If the fight goes badly, Orin and Seren will help everyone recover.

third_plan.narration: Your third account is ready. Work it into today's map before the fight. It is a place you learned, not something you took.

wyrm_plan.narration: The wyrm waits with its builder at the outer ice rib. Help give the low signal, and keep the loose edge clear so it can brace.

olivia_plan.narration: Olivia offers her help from the safe brace point. "A condition," she says, "not a command." She will follow your signals, the ones Seren teaches.

third_account.narration: You name the third place and point to it on today's map. Seren checks the match.

wyrm_support.narration: Hold the builder's signal cloth while she calls. The wyrm curls against the loose outer ice. Nobody sends it into the tear.

interaction.cue: Hold the signal cloth steady.

onSuccess.narration: The wyrm braces the edge. One crawler slips home.

onFailure.narration: The wyrm braces the edge. One crawler slips home.

onAssisted.narration: The wyrm braces the edge. One crawler slips home.

olivia_support.narration: Seren shows the signals: hold, ease, hold. Copy them for Olivia.

interaction.cue: Copy the brace signals for Olivia.

onSuccess.narration: Olivia follows you. One crawler slips home.

onAssisted.narration: Seren will lead instead.

olivia_help.narration: Hold the brace while Seren gives Olivia the hold and ease calls.

interaction.cue: Hold the brace for Seren's calls.

onAssisted.narration: One crawler slips home.

support_ready.narration: The extra help has narrowed the tear. Corvane has less room to pull, and only one crawler is left beside him.

fight_standard.narration: Corvane fights to keep the last seam open, and two bone crawlers scuttle out of its light. Drive them off, or hold the ridge brace for four turns to close the seam.

objectives.label: Hold the ridge and close the last seam

fight_standard_braced.narration: Corvane fights to keep the last seam open, and two bone crawlers scuttle out of its light. Drive them off, or hold the fitted ridge brace for three turns to close the seam.

objectives.label: Hold the ridge and close the last seam

fight_weakened.narration: Corvane fights to keep the last seam open, and one bone crawler scuttles out of its light. Drive them off, or hold the ridge brace for four turns to close the seam.

objectives.label: Hold the ridge and close the last seam

fight_weakened_braced.narration: Corvane fights to keep the last seam open, and one bone crawler scuttles out of its light. Drive them off, or hold the fitted ridge brace for three turns to close the seam.

objectives.label: Hold the ridge and close the last seam

spent.narration: The last seam closes. Corvane lowers his hands, his strength spent. The crawlers slip away. The glacier grows so quiet you can hear the ribbon fall onto the old map. "It was a very good map," he says. The yeti watcher comes to meet you.

variants.text: You held the brace until the seam closed. Nobody had to knock Corvane down.
The blurred corner of the old map is still drying. Orin leaves that patch blank for now.

help_him.narration: The watcher brings a blanket big enough for Corvane. His mustache has escaped its ribbon, and he looks like someone who has been cold for a very long time. "Offer to help," the watcher whispers. "Ask before you wrap or move him."

home_now.narration: The land has stopped moving. "Where did my river go?" Corvane asks. The watcher can tell him about her valley, or you can lay the two maps side by side.

variants.text: Some places have already shifted. You mark what still needs checking.

unpack_map.narration: Corvane opens the case himself and smooths one corner with the back of his hand. The dry old map lies beside today's map. Nothing needs to come through the tear.

home_maps.narration: You lay a broad pointer beside today's river and the homes along it. Corvane follows the line. For once, he looks at the people's marks on the new map before checking the old one.

home_watcher.narration: The watcher tells of her walking path, and of the room where yetis read memories in old ice. What should Corvane hear about the living valley?

fate.narration: The yetis offer two safe futures. Corvane can rest in a quiet chamber in the ice, where his memory will be kept. Or he can live with the yetis and learn the names of the world as it is now. He looks at the open path, then at the quiet ice. You may choose with him.

keepers.narration: The yetis make a quiet place in the ice. Corvane folds his map and steps inside beneath his blanket. "Wake me if the rivers ever forget their way." The ice keeps him, and he keeps the memory. The land stays still. In the records of the glacier, your party is called the Glacier Keepers.

variants.text: The moved places settle back home.
You stopped the last pull, but some places are still shifted. Keeping the rest safe has left a scar on the map.

listened.narration: Corvane sits at a broad table with the yetis who read memories in the old ice, the present map before him. "Then tell me what you call this valley now." The watcher begins with the path outside the door. He listens. The land stays still. In the records of the glacier, your party is called the Ones Who Listened.

variants.text: The moved places settle back home.
You stopped the last pull, but some places are still shifted. Keeping the rest safe has left a scar on the map.

keepers_epilogue.narration: The Riftseekers write down the places you helped and the choices you made. The chime hangs beside a plain walking door. The watcher opens it by hand, and a small goat outside tries to eat the welcome mat.

variants.text: Olivia joins Orin at the study table, testing one thing at a time.
Olivia helps the watchers hold the last loose ground.
Olivia packs her notebook and heads off to study on her own.
The builders keep the sheltered hollow open. Their big neighbor rumbles hello.
Later, a temple message says the landing is mended.
Later, the temple keepers watch the returned island drift gently clear.
Pip stays with Bram on the safe side of the line.
Pip follows Olivia, the retreat signal copied in his notebook.

listened_epilogue.narration: The Riftseekers write down the places you helped and the choices you made. The chime hangs beside a plain walking door. The watcher opens it by hand, and a small goat outside tries to eat the welcome mat.

variants.text: Olivia joins Orin at the study table, testing one thing at a time.
Olivia helps the watchers hold the last loose ground.
Olivia packs her notebook and heads off to study on her own.
The builders keep the sheltered hollow open. Their big neighbor rumbles hello.
Later, a temple message says the landing is mended.
Later, the temple keepers watch the returned island drift gently clear.
Pip stays with Bram on the safe side of the line.
Pip follows Olivia, the retreat signal copied in his notebook.

rivers_wander.narration: The Riftseekers spread out to watch the changed roads. Some lands are still jumbled, but everyone came out safely. In the glacier records, this story is called Rivers Wander. Orin folds the old joining lines under a new page. "Then we learn the new map." The watcher opens the plain door onto tomorrow.

loss_epilogue.narration: You rest while the first messengers set out. The people you helped know how to begin. A small goat noses a closed map case, decides it is a poor breakfast, and goes looking for a welcome mat.

variants.text: Olivia joins Orin at the study table, testing one thing at a time.
Olivia helps the watchers hold the last loose ground.
Olivia packs her notebook and heads off to study on her own.
The builders keep the sheltered hollow open. Their big neighbor rumbles hello.
Pip stays with Bram on the safe side of the line.
Pip follows Olivia, the retreat signal copied in his notebook.

loss_second_failed.narration: Orin and Seren bring everyone back along the marked lane. The last pull fades, and so does the opening, but more lands have moved. Nobody goes back tonight. Corvane follows the watcher out, carrying a map that no longer fits.

loss_recover.narration: Everyone falls back to the watcher behind the ice rib for blankets and broth. Some places have shifted, any extra help is used up, and the last seam still pulls. One more chance: when the pull pauses, set the ridge brace.

loss_watch.narration: Everyone is safe with the watcher. First, mark how far it is safe to go when you set the brace. The watcher's lamp can show it. So can a handline or cloth marks, if you set them earlier.

loss_lamp.narration: Pass the watcher's lamp to the first safe spot while Seren watches for the pause.

interaction.cue: Pass the lamp to the safe spot.

onAssisted.narration: The safe edge is marked.

loss_line.narration: Hold your handline along the inside wall while Seren checks how far it is safe to go. Nobody steps into the opening.

interaction.cue: Hold the handline steady.

onAssisted.narration: The safe edge is marked.

loss_marks.narration: Copy the route marks you learned: wall, rib, passage, wall. Show the watcher where you will set the brace.

interaction.cue: Copy the cloth route for the watcher.

onSuccess.narration: The watcher can see the brace spot.

onAssisted.narration: Use the watcher's lamp instead.

loss_anchor_plan.narration: The pull pauses beside the ridge. Orin guides today's map from the rescue lane, and Seren helps hold the ridge. Set the brace now. If it holds, the seam closes. If not, more lands will move.

loss_anchor_check.narration: When the pull pauses, set the padded ridge brace. The pause is short. Seren can guide it with you.

interaction.cue: Set the ridge brace during the safe pause.

onSuccess.narration: The brace holds, and the seam folds shut.

onFailure.narration: The ridge slips. Everyone hurries back to the watcher.

onAssisted.narration: The brace holds, and the seam folds shut.

loss_anchor_supported.narration: When the pull pauses, set the padded ridge brace. Your rescue lamp makes the pause easier to see. Seren can guide it with you.

interaction.cue: Set the ridge brace during the safe pause.

onSuccess.narration: The brace holds, and the seam folds shut.

onFailure.narration: The ridge slips. Everyone hurries back to the watcher.

onAssisted.narration: The brace holds, and the seam folds shut.

loss_anchor_reserved.narration: Orin and Seren stayed back for this moment. Hold their padded support while they set the brace together.

interaction.cue: Hold the support for Orin and Seren.

onSuccess.narration: The brace holds, and the seam folds shut.

onFailure.narration: The brace holds, and the seam folds shut.

onAssisted.narration: The brace holds, and the seam folds shut.

voices_response_homes.narration: He looks beyond the river line for the first time. The figure steps where you can see him clearly.

voices_response_map.narration: He leans toward the page without stepping nearer your party. The figure steps where you can see him clearly.

voices_response_people.narration: He follows your hand toward the living shore. The figure steps where you can see him clearly.

help_him_response_blanket.narration: He takes the blanket and gathers it around his shoulders. The way out stays open.

help_him_response_path.narration: The watcher waits for him to choose to stand. The way out stays open.

help_him_response_ribbon.narration: He holds out the loose end instead of reaching toward the closed seam. The way out stays open.

home_watcher_response_path.narration: The watcher starts with the ordinary path outside her door. Corvane leaves his map lines alone.

home_watcher_response_room.narration: She describes the readers carrying their own notes. Corvane leaves his map lines alone.

home_watcher_response_home.narration: Corvane listens to names his old map never held. He leaves his map lines alone.
